title: Building LR(0) item sets
description: You can follow closure and goto as they construct a six-state automaton.

steps.description: Each item stores a nonterminal, a production and a dot position. closure adds productions for the nonterminal after a dot until a pass adds nothing.
goto_set advances matching dots by one and closes the resulting set. You start the state collection with the closure of S' -> . S.

steps.question: What happens when goto_set returns a state already in state_map?
steps.answer: The loop records a transition to its existing number. It adds a state to the work list only when the item set is new.

steps.description: You process each new item set across all listed symbols. Nonempty goto results become transitions keyed by the current state and symbol.
The output lists six states with dots marking progress through productions. You can see the completed S' -> S item in state 1 and the completed parenthesized production in state 5.
